e.title: Azure Medical Claims Processing
e.summary: Azure 官方医疗理赔处理参考（45★，.NET）：Functions+Cosmos DB+OpenAI+Event Hubs 事件驱动理赔
e.body: Medical-Claims-Transaction-Processing-at-scale（Azure，45★，.NET，2025-05 活跃）是 Azure 官方代码示例：用 Azure Functions + Cosmos DB + Azure OpenAI Service + Event Hubs 实现事件驱动的医疗保险理赔流程（成员/提供方/支付方三方场景）——理赔流式提交入库、业务规则自动或人工审批、AI 副驾驶（co-pilot）为处理代理提供理赔处理建议；少量修改可迁移到其他保险流程。对 RIAA：医疗理赔的事件驱动 + AI 副驾驶参考架构（Azure 路线）——与 [[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]]（理赔自动化加速器）、[[workbenchiq]]（核保理赔工作台）、[[claims-processing-hack]]（理赔黑客松）构成微软系理赔方案族；配 [[medicare-claims-pricer]]（CMS 定价引擎）理解美国医疗理赔上下文。

e.summary_en: Azure official medical-claims reference (45★, .NET): Functions + Cosmos DB + OpenAI + Event Hubs event-driven claims
e.summary_hk: Azure 官方醫療理賠處理參考（45★，.NET）：Functions+Cosmos DB+OpenAI+Event Hubs 事件驅動理賠
e.body_en: Medical-Claims-Transaction-Processing-at-scale (Azure, 45★, .NET, active 2025-05) is an Azure official code sample: an event-driven medical insurance claims process built with Azure Functions + Cosmos DB + Azure OpenAI Service + Azure Event Hubs (member/provider/payer scenario) — claims submitted in a stream are loaded into the backing database for review and approval, business rules drive automated or human approval, and an AI co-pilot empowers agents with claim-processing recommendations; with minimal changes it generalises to other insurance processes. For RIAA: an event-driven + AI co-pilot reference architecture for medical claims (the Azure route) — with [[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]] (claims automation accelerator), [[workbenchiq]] (underwriting/claims workbench) and [[claims-processing-hack]] (claims hackathon) it forms the Microsoft-family claims-solution suite; pair with [[medicare-claims-pricer]] (the CMS pricing engine) for US medical-claims context.
e.body_hk: Medical-Claims-Transaction-Processing-at-scale（Azure，45★，.NET，2025-05 活躍）是 Azure 官方程式碼示例：用 Azure Functions + Cosmos DB + Azure OpenAI Service + Event Hubs 實現事件驅動的醫療保險理賠流程（成員/提供方/支付方三方場景）——理賠流式提交入庫、業務規則自動或人工審批、AI 副駕駛（co-pilot）為處理代理提供理賠處理建議；少量修改可遷移到其他保險流程。對 RIAA：醫療理賠的事件驅動 + AI 副駕駛參考架構（Azure 路線）——與 [[ms-claims-automation-accelerator]]（理賠自動化加速器）、[[workbenchiq]]（核保理賠工作台）、[[claims-processing-hack]]（理賠黑客松）構成微軟系理賠方案族；配 [[medicare-claims-pricer]]（CMS 定價引擎）理解美國醫療理賠上下文。
